title: Clear flashing ESTOP fault at the operator station using HMI RESET
summary: If the operator station ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP and press RESET on the operator station HMI to clear faults so startup actions (homing/cycle start) can proceed.
when_to_use: Use when the operator station control panel shows the ESTOP is flashing and you need to clear the fault condition so you can proceed with operator station startup actions (homing/cycle start).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical ESTOP pull-out and use the operator station HMI RESET to clear the flashing ESTOP fault condition.
safety_notes: Only the operator should perform physical E-stop actions.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator station HMI screen with RESET

system_preconditions: Operator station ESTOP is flashing (fault condition present).

steps.title: Check whether the operator station ESTOP is flashing
steps.purpose: Confirm the flashing ESTOP condition before attempting reset.
steps.instruction: At the operator station control panel, check whether the ESTOP is flashing.
steps.expected_result: The ESTOP status is observed as flashing (fault condition present).
steps.healthy_condition: ESTOP is not flashing (no flashing fault condition present).
steps.failure_condition: ESTOP is flashing but you proceed without confirming the flashing condition.

actions.label: Inspect ESTOP indicator
actions.exact_action: Check whether the ESTOP is flashing.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: At the operator station control panel, if the ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP and press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults.

steps.title: Pull out the ESTOP if it is flashing
steps.purpose: Physically clear the flashing ESTOP condition as required by the startup procedure.
steps.instruction: If the ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP.
steps.expected_result: The ESTOP has been pulled out (physical ESTOP action completed).
steps.healthy_condition: ESTOP is no longer in the flashing state after the pull-out action.
steps.failure_condition: ESTOP remains flashing after the pull-out action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: At the operator station control panel, if the ESTOP is flashing, pull out the ESTOP and press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults.

steps.title: Press HMI RESET to clear faults
steps.purpose: Clear the faults indicated by the flashing ESTOP condition using the HMI RESET control.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI screen, press RESET to clear any faults.
steps.expected_result: After pressing RESET, the flashing ESTOP fault condition is cleared (the ESTOP is no longer flashing).
steps.healthy_condition: Flashing ESTOP condition is no longer present after RESET.
steps.failure_condition: ESTOP remains flashing after pulling out the ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET.

actions.label: Press RESET
actions.exact_action: press RESET on the HMI screen to clear any faults

stop_or_escalate_if: If the ESTOP remains flashing after pulling out ESTOP and pressing HMI RESET, stop and escalate rather than continuing with homing/cycle start.

steps.title: Confirm the flashing ESTOP condition is cleared before proceeding
steps.purpose: Ensure the fault condition is actually cleared before attempting startup actions.

steps.failure_condition: ESTOP is still flashing after reset.

actions.exact_action: Confirm the fault condition is cleared (i.e., proceed only if the flashing ESTOP condition is no longer present).
